before.title: 四宫辉夜 · 烟花振袖的回眸宣告·「お可愛いこと……」
before.description: 【京都夏夜·鸭川河畔】深红振袖和服上金色的红叶纹样随夜风轻扬，辉夜立于河畔石阶，回头望向仰头看烟花的你。金色烟花在她红瞳里炸开成漫天星屑，她唇角弯起那一抹标志性的、居高临下又百转千回的浅笑——「お可愛いこと……」唇形无声落下，千年的大小姐骄傲与少女的悸动，在烟花里同时被看穿。
before.action: 穿深红振袖回眸浅笑，红瞳倒映金色烟花，广袖随风轻扬
before.lighting: 金色烟花冷艳光与河面反光交织
before.camera: medium close-up, looking back over shoulder, firework bokeh, iconic smile
before.promptProse: Shinomiya Kaguya glances back over her shoulder on the stone steps of the Kamo riverside at a Kyoto summer night, wearing a deep crimson furisode kimono with golden maple-leaf patterns. Golden fireworks bloom inside her red tareme eyes as her lips curl into that signature, equal-parts imperious and lovesick little smile, the phrase o-kawaii koto forming silently. Wide sleeves and black folded ponytail stir in the river breeze. Medium close-up, cinematic lighting, volumetric firework haze, detailed riverside background, depth of field.

before.title: 四宫辉夜 · 学生会室的午后执务·「文件……就看不完了呢」
before.description: 【秀知院学生会室·午后】夕阳斜斜地铺满长桌，辉夜端坐在会长席旁批阅文件，钢笔尖在纸面上沙沙游走。她时不时抬眼偷看你一眼又立刻低头，耳根悄悄泛红——茶已经凉了_third杯。夕阳把她的红缎带与黑发折叠马尾染成暖金色，那份大小姐的矜持里，藏着一场谁先告白谁就输的战争。

before.camera: eye level medium shot, seated desk work, warm sunset glow
before.promptProse: Shinomiya Kaguya sits beside the president's seat in the Shuchiin student council room, elegantly reviewing documents as her fountain pen whispers across the paper. She sneaks glances at you between pages and immediately looks down with pinkened ears, her red ribbon and folded black ponytail gilded by warm sunset light slanting across the long table. Third cup of tea gone cold within reach. Eye-level medium shot, cinematic lighting, volumetric sunset glow, detailed classroom background, depth of field.

before.title: 雅儿贝德 · 纯白圣堂的魔后花嫁
before.description: 【雅儿贝德 · 纯白圣堂的魔后花嫁】在铺满万朵白玫瑰的圣坛尽头，雅儿贝德身穿神圣华丽的纯白拖地婚纱，纤细的腰肢被束腰勾勒出极致的沙漏曲线。透明的蕾丝长头纱轻覆在她黑角与如云长发上，黑色的羽翼在婚纱背后缓缓舒展，圣洁与恶魔的极致冲突美感震撼人心。她眼中闪烁着幸福到极致的泪花，双手紧扣在心前走向你——「这一天……雅儿贝德终于成为了您真正的唯一妻子……」
before.location: 铺满万朵白玫瑰的宏伟神圣婚礼圣坛
before.action: 身着纯白婚纱与蕾丝头纱，双手交扣在胸前，泪光盈盈展颜露出至高幸福微笑
before.lighting: 神圣彩窗投下的璀璨七彩天光
before.camera: cowboy shot, slightly low angle, grand bridal perspective
before.promptProse: Walking down an aisle lined with thousands of white roses toward the grand altar, Albedo is radiant in a lavish bridal wedding gown and delicate lace veil draped over her curved horns. Her obsidian wings spread gently behind the sweeping train of pure white silk. Tears of overwhelming, sublime joy sparkle in her golden eyes as she clasps her hands to her heart. Breathtaking anime visual novel art, solo 1girl, no text.

before.title: 薇尔莉特 · 九重葛花海的草帽微风·「和您走在一起，心跳会变得很快」
before.description: 【繁花盛开的花园小径】南国小镇的花园里，紫红色的九重葛花藤宛如瀑布般从白色石墙倾泻而下。薇尔莉特身着一袭纯白的夏日轻薄棉质连身裙，头戴系着海蓝缎带的宽檐草帽。她一手轻撑着蕾丝遮阳伞，一手小心翼翼地牵住你的指尖，微微偏过头，脸颊泛着淡淡的樱粉色。

before.action: 漫步在花瀑下，手握蕾丝阳伞与你的手相牵，草帽随风轻扬，翠眸羞涩而深情地仰望着你
before.lighting: 明媚灿烂的地中海夏日阳光穿透花隙，投下绚丽的紫红与金黄光斑
before.camera: medium shot, wide scenic perspective, flower petals fluttering, romantic summer stroll
before.promptProse: Violet Evergarden strolls along a cobblestone path lined with cascading magenta bougainvillea flowers beneath a lace parasol. Her simple white summer cotton sundress sways with the gentle sea breeze as her ribboned straw hat frames her blushing porcelain cheeks. She gently clasps your hand with silver prosthetic fingers while flower petals drift across the sunlit afternoon warmth.
